
---
title: "AllCountries Dataset"
subtitle: "Variable codebook"
---

The `AllCountries` dataset contains country-level measures of population, health, economics, energy, and human development.

## Dataset structure

The data frame contains **217 countries** and **29 variables**. Most values describe 2023 or the most recently available year.

## Variables

| Variable | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `Country` | Country name. |
| `Code` | Three-letter country code. |
| `LandArea` | Land area in thousands of square kilometers. |
| `Population` | Population in millions. |
| `Density` | Number of people per square kilometer. |
| `GDP` | Gross domestic product per capita, in US dollars. |
| `Rural` | Percentage of the population living in rural areas. |
| `CO2` | Carbon dioxide emissions in metric tons per capita. |
| `PumpPrice` | Price of one liter of gasoline, in US dollars. |
| `Military` | Percentage of government expenditures directed toward the military. |
| `Health` | Percentage of government expenditures directed toward healthcare. |
| `ArmedForces` | Number of active-duty military personnel, in thousands. |
| `Internet` | Percentage of the population with internet access. |
| `Cell` | Cell-phone subscriptions per 100 people. |
| `HIV` | Percentage of the population with HIV. |
| `Hunger` | Percentage of the population considered undernourished. |
| `Diabetes` | Percentage of the population diagnosed with diabetes. |
| `BirthRate` | Births per 1,000 people. |
| `DeathRate` | Deaths per 1,000 people. |
| `ElderlyPop` | Percentage of the population aged 65 or older. |
| `LifeExpectancy` | Average life expectancy, in years. |
| `FemaleLabor` | Percentage of females aged 15 to 64 in the labor force. |
| `Unemployment` | Percentage of the labor force that is unemployed. |
| `Renewable` | Percentage of energy from renewable sources. |
| `Energy` | Total energy consumption in million BTU per capita. |
| `Electricity` | Electric power consumption in kWh per capita. |
| `Developed` | Electricity-use category: 1 = under 2,500 kWh per capita; 2 = 2,500 to 5,000; 3 = over 5,000. |
| `HDI` | Human Development Index, the United Nations measure of social and economic well-being, on a 0 to 1 scale. |
| `HDIGroup` | Human Development Index category: Very High, High, Medium, or Low. |

## Data notes and sources

This version is updated for the fourth edition and replaces earlier editions (`AllCountries1e`, `AllCountries2e`, and `AllCountries3e`).

- Most indicators: [World Bank Open Data](https://data.worldbank.org/)
- Gasoline prices: [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/gasoline-prices?continent=world)
- Energy and electricity: [U.S. Energy Information Administration](https://www.eia.gov/international/data/world#/)
- Human Development Index: [United Nations Human Development Reports](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/human-development-index#/indicies/HDI)

Sources were accessed in January 2025. The dataset is distributed through the [`Lock5Data` package](https://www.lock5stat.com/datapage4e.html), version 4.0.1.
